artists.source_line: Kizz-N Organisation has the right to update the Festival.

features.rationale: The event lists 35 hours of workshops as part of the programme.
The event has three dance rooms.
The programme includes an afternoon social from 16:00 to 20:00.
Masterclasses are offered, booked extra via Ticketlink.
Taxi teams are listed as part of the event.
A main hotel is recommended with a special discount code, without accommodation being part of the pass.
A transfer section gives airport and station transfer information to the venue.
